title: Clause 8 - Operation
description: Working paper template for ISO/IEC 42001 Clause 8: operational planning and control of the AI lifecycle.

sections.title: Operational planning and control (8.1)
prompts: Verify processes for the AI lifecycle (design, develop, deploy, operate, retire) are documented.
Confirm process owners and operational metrics.

sections.title: AI risk treatment implementation (8.2 / 8.3)
prompts: Confirm risk treatment actions are implemented as planned.
Verify residual risks are tracked and accepted by the right authority.

sections.title: AI supplier and component management
prompts: Identify suppliers of models, datasets, infrastructure.
Verify due diligence and contractual obligations cover AI risks (model cards, evals, IP).

checklists.text: Risk treatments traceable to risks they mitigate.
Residual risk acceptance recorded with date and approver.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Walk us through how a new AI use case moves from idea to production.
How do you assure AI-related supplier obligations?
Show us evidence that risk treatment plans are being executed.
